title: polygonatum × krylovii
intro: Polygonatum × krylovii, commonly known as Krylov's Solomon's seal, is a hybrid plant species within the Asparagaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Krylov's Solomon's seal are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
